messages.text: why cant i fash my dc06 with harlos
Searched the web · Harlo OS supported models harlolabs firmware Hammer DC06

Hi, I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed this over to me.

Short answer: the DC06 is not on the Harlo OS supported list yet, so the flasher will not offer it as a model.


The current list is 17 models from 7 manufacturers
, and on the Hammer side it covers 
the BC04, DC02, DC08 and Thor P2
. The D.06 is missing from it. 
Not on the list means not yet rather than never, and JD adds models most weeks.


So for now:

1. Stay on the Hammer DC06 stock firmware for that unit. If it is misbehaving, tell me what it is doing and I will help you with the stock side.
2. If you have a DC02, DC08, BC04 or Thor P2 as well, those flash fine from the flasher at harlolabs.com in Chrome or Edge with a USB data cable.
3. To push for DC06 support, ask for it in the Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate (JD, who builds Harlo OS). He takes model requests there.

Was there a specific problem on the DC06 you were hoping Harlo OS would fix (hashrate, screen, pool settings)? If so, tell me the symptom and the firmware version showing in its web UI and I will take it from there.

Can you tell me which one you mean?

1. Flash Harlo OS onto the DC06: not possible today, the model is not in the flasher yet.
2. Reflash the DC06 with its own stock Hammer firmware (for example if it boots into recovery mode or the UI is stuck): that I can walk you through.
3. Flash Harlo OS onto a different unit you own (DC02, DC08, BC04, Thor P2).

Which is it? If it is number 2, tell me what the unit is doing right now and what the screen shows, and we will start there.
